why: Scores: base STR 15 DEX 14 CON 13 INT 12 WIS 10 CHA 8 plus Soldier (STR +2, CON +1) = STR 17 (+3), DEX 14 (+2), CON 14 (+2), INT 12 (+1), WIS 10 (0), CHA 8 (-1). INT is 14 here. Fighter 5 + Warmage 7 (House of Knights), character level 12, PB 2+(12-1)//4 = 4. House of Knights 7 gives a Fighting Style feat of choice (m0:sfs7 = Defense, the Fighter picked Archery). AC: Chain Mail 16 + Defense 1 = 17 (Defense only counts with armor). HP: Fighter level 1 = 10+2 = 12, Fighter levels 2-5 = 4x(6+2) = 32, Warmage d8 7 levels = 7x(5+2) = 49, total 93. Saves only from the first class: STR 3+4 = 7, CON 2+4 = 6, INT 2 (no proficiency from Warmage).
